qa.title: Q2578 (Nov. 6, 2026)
qa.question: On my 4th turn, I play Marwynn, Omen of Repose's "Skip your next turn: Evolve this follower" ability, increasing my max play points by 1 due to its On Evolve ability. On my next turn, which happens after 2 of my opponent's turns, does this follower cost 6 less?
qa.answer: No. It costs 5 less. Although you would have 6 max play points, skipped turns do not count towards turns passed.

qa.title: Q2577 (Nov. 6, 2026)
qa.question: What does "turns passed" mean?
qa.answer: A player's turns passed is the number of times they have begun their start phase as the active player for the first time in a turn.
